text.darkmusic.set_executable_paths_and_: Set executable paths and check yt-dlp, FFmpeg, FFprobe, and optional JavaScript runtime.
text.darkmusic.paste_a_video_or_collecti: Paste a video or collection URL
text.darkmusic.identify_the_source_and_p: Identify the source and preview up to 100 entries. Nothing downloads automatically.
text.darkmusic.choose_this_video_only_se: Choose This Video Only, selected preview entries, First N, a range, or explicitly All Entries. Mixes have no stable end.
text.darkmusic.first_n_number_of_entries: First N: number of entries. Range: first entry number, starting at 1.
text.darkmusic.range_last_entry_number_i: Range: last entry number, inclusive. For 10–30, enter 10 and 30.
text.darkmusic.queue_only_the_explicitly: Queue only the explicitly chosen selection into the current music folder. Up to 1,000 entries per batch; larger collections need separate ranges. Download only content you are authorized to save.
text.darkmusic.switch_between_collection: Switch between collection preview and download queue. Closing this screen does not cancel the queue.
text.darkmusic.preview_the_previous_page: Preview the previous page. Checked entries are kept across pages.
text.darkmusic.preview_the_next_page_thi: Preview the next page; this does not download it.
text.darkmusic.check_every_entry_on_this: Check every entry on this preview page. Download Selected Preview includes checks kept from other pages.
text.darkmusic.clear_all_preview_checks_: Clear all preview checks, including hidden pages.
text.darkmusic.cancel_the_selected_queue: Cancel the selected queued or active item; other downloads continue.
text.darkmusic.cancel_url_analysis_activ: Cancel URL analysis, active work, and queued entries. Completed songs are kept.
text.darkmusic.remove_saved_skipped_fail: Remove saved, skipped, failed, and cancelled rows from the queue; saved audio is kept.
text.darkmusic.this_is_a_collection_url_: This is a collection URL. Choose selected entries, First N, or a range.
text.darkmusic.check_at_least_one_previe: Check at least one preview entry.
text.darkmusic.this_collection_mix_has_n: This collection/Mix has no known end. Choose First N or a range.
text.darkmusic.analyze_a_url_to_preview_: Analyze a URL to Preview Entries
text.darkmusic.only_authorized_public_co: Only authorized public content. Tools are installed separately.
text.darkmusic.auto_instance_tools_direc: Auto: instance tools directory, then PATH
text.darkmusic.paste_the_executable_file: Paste the executable file's full path. Leave blank for automatic lookup. No tools are downloaded, installed, or updated automatically.
text.darkmusic.auto_deno_or_node_on_path: Auto: Deno or Node on PATH; YouTube may require this
text.darkmusic.audio_files_will_only_be_: Audio files will only be read.
text.darkmusic.scale_the_entire_hud_from: Scale the entire HUD from 50%% to 200%%. Drag the preview to move it. Escape saves and returns.
text.darkmusic.drag_the_hud_to_move_it_e: Drag the HUD to move it. Escape saves and returns.
text.darkmusic.music_folder_autoplay_bac: Music folder, autoplay, background music, and HUD layout. Assign shortcuts in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
text.darkmusic.create_and_edit_playlists: Create and edit playlists. To listen, use the Playlists view below. Escape closes the player.
text.darkmusic.search_title_artist_album: Search title, artist, album or path
text.darkmusic.songs_enter_or_double_cli: Songs; Enter or double click to play
text.darkmusic.seek_in_the_original_song: Seek in the original song's timeline. Compressed files may take a moment to seek.
text.darkmusic.previous_song_in_playback: Previous song in playback history, or restart the current song.
text.darkmusic.start_the_selected_song_w: Start the selected song when stopped; otherwise pause or resume current playback.
text.darkmusic.next_song_in_the_playback: Next song in the playback queue.
text.darkmusic.stop_playback_and_reset_i: Stop playback and reset its position.
text.darkmusic.shuffle_play_the_queue_in: Shuffle: play the queue in randomized order. Off restores its normal order.
text.darkmusic.repeat_off_stops_at_the_q: Repeat OFF stops at the queue's end; ONE repeats the current song; ALL repeats the queue. Click to cycle.
text.darkmusic.darkmusic_volume_independ: DarkMusic volume, independent of Minecraft sound sliders.
text.darkmusic.playback_speed_0_5x_to_3_: Playback speed: 0.5x to 3.0x in 0.1x steps. Faster raises pitch; slower lowers it.
text.darkmusic.open_the_selected_music_f: Open the selected music folder in your file manager.
text.darkmusic.paste_a_video_collection_: Paste a video/collection URL, choose entries, and queue MP3 downloads into your music folder.
text.darkmusic.songs_are_discovered_auto: Songs are discovered automatically. Refresh now if changes were missed or a drive was reconnected.
text.darkmusic.create_a_playlist_with_ma: Create a playlist with Manage Playlists.
text.darkmusic.this_playlist_is_empty_ad: This playlist is empty. Add Songs in Manage Playlists.
text.darkmusic.click_twice_to_delete_the: Click twice to delete the selected playlist.
text.darkmusic.select_library_songs_not_: Select library songs not already added to this playlist.
text.darkmusic.remove_all_checked_entrie: Remove all checked entries from this playlist.
text.darkmusic.select_every_entry_includ: Select every entry, including missing songs. Ctrl/Cmd+A works with list focus.
text.darkmusic.move_selected_songs_up_wh: Move selected songs up while preserving their relative order.
text.darkmusic.move_selected_songs_down_: Move selected songs down while preserving their relative order.
text.darkmusic.remove_this_entry_then_ad: Remove this entry, then add the current file with Add Songs
text.darkmusic.automatically_start_the_l: Automatically start the library after Minecraft launches. Disabled by default.
text.darkmusic.choose_the_local_folder_c: Choose the local folder containing your music. Subfolders are included.
text.darkmusic.stop_minecraft_s_backgrou: Stop Minecraft's background music while keeping ordinary sound effects.
text.darkmusic.independent_player_hud_sp: Independent player/HUD spectra, bars, sensitivity, smoothing, size, and HUD position.
text.darkmusic.show_the_current_song_dur: Show the current song during gameplay. Hidden with F1 and while menus are open.
text.darkmusic.show_embedded_artwork_on_: Show embedded artwork on the left of the HUD, preserving its proportions.
text.darkmusic.show_the_current_track_s_: Show the current track's progress below the title and artist.
text.darkmusic.drag_the_preview_anywhere: Drag the preview anywhere on screen and adjust the scale of the entire HUD.
text.darkmusic.switch_settings_pages_cha: Switch settings pages. Changes save automatically; Escape returns.
text.darkmusic.select_every_visible_song: Select every visible song. Ctrl/Cmd+A works when the list is focused.
text.darkmusic.clear_selections_includin: Clear selections, including songs hidden by search.
text.darkmusic.toggle_selection_of_visib: Toggle selection of visible songs; hidden selections are kept.
text.darkmusic.add_selected_songs_in_lib: Add Selected songs in library order. Songs already added are hidden.
text.darkmusic.return_without_changing_t: Return without changing the playlist. Escape also cancels.
text.darkmusic.all_library_songs_are_alr: All Library Songs Are Already Added
text.darkmusic.drag_the_spectrum_play_mu: Drag the spectrum. Play music for a live preview; Escape saves.
text.darkmusic.real_audio_spectrum_below: Real audio spectrum below the artwork; compact layouts use the right of the status row.
text.darkmusic.independent_of_the_now_pl: Independent of the now-playing HUD. Hidden with F1 and while menus are open.
text.darkmusic.8_64_logarithmic_frequenc: 8–64 logarithmic frequency bands, from bass to treble. Narrow areas combine bars to fit.
text.darkmusic.boost_quiet_spectra_or_re: Boost quiet spectra or reduce strong levels. Samples follow playback speed and DarkMusic volume.
text.darkmusic.higher_values_give_slower: Higher values give slower attack and decay. Pausing freezes the actual spectrum; stop and seek clear it.
text.darkmusic.hud_height_and_preferred_: HUD height and preferred player height, limited by available space without moving playback controls.
format.darkmusic.selected_hidden: %s Selected (%s Hidden). Shift: Range; Ctrl/Cmd: Toggle
format.darkmusic.missing_entries: %s unavailable song(s); select missing entries in Manage Playlists.
text.darkmusic.the_site_is_rate_limiting: The site is rate limiting downloads (429). Wait before retrying.
text.darkmusic.the_site_refused_access_4: The site refused access (403). Try a current yt-dlp version or another public entry.
text.darkmusic.this_entry_is_private_res: This entry is private, restricted, or requires authentication. Access controls are not bypassed.
text.darkmusic.yt_dlp_does_not_support_t: yt-dlp does not support this URL or collection.
text.darkmusic.not_enough_disk_space_fre: Not enough disk space. Free space in the music and temporary directories.
text.darkmusic.youtube_needs_a_compatibl: YouTube needs a compatible Deno/Node runtime and current yt-dlp. Check Download Tools.
text.darkmusic.network_request_timed_out: Network request timed out or failed. Check your connection and retry.
text.darkmusic.paste_a_single_http_or_ht: Paste a single HTTP or HTTPS video/collection URL.
text.darkmusic.enter_a_valid_http_or_htt: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without login credentials.
text.darkmusic.download_history_is_too_l: Download history is too large. Preserve it and choose another folder.
text.darkmusic.the_selected_music_folder: The selected music folder is not writable.
text.darkmusic.not_enough_disk_space_in_: Not enough disk space in the music folder.
text.darkmusic.the_converted_file_failed: The converted file failed MP3 validation.
text.darkmusic.no_video_was_found_at_thi: No video was found at this URL.
text.darkmusic.this_url_is_not_a_support: This URL is not a supported collection. Choose This Video Only.
text.darkmusic.there_are_no_entries_in_t: There are no entries in that selection.
text.darkmusic.download_workspace_must_n: Download workspace must not be a symbolic link
text.darkmusic.another_minecraft_instanc: Another Minecraft instance is using these download tools. Close it before downloading here.
text.darkmusic.download_scratch_folder_m: Download scratch folder must not be a symbolic link
text.darkmusic.tool_output_exceeded_the_: Tool output exceeded the allowed line length
text.darkmusic.tool_timed_out_check_your: Tool timed out. Check your connection or try a smaller selection.
text.darkmusic.this_yt_dlp_is_incompatib: This yt-dlp is incompatible. Update it from github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases.
text.darkmusic.ffmpeg_must_include_the_l: FFmpeg must include the libmp3lame MP3 encoder.
text.darkmusic.javascript_runtime_must_b: JavaScript runtime must be a Deno or Node executable.
text.darkmusic.could_not_identify_the_ja: Could not identify the JavaScript runtime version.
text.darkmusic.youtube_needs_deno_2_3_or: YouTube needs Deno 2.3+ or Node 22+. Update the selected JavaScript runtime.
